transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because my brain just kind of stalls. At work I’ll have a test report open, or even a simple CAD note, and I’ll sit there for an hour not knowing what sentence to write or which box to check. It’s been… hard to function like that.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess I have. Stuff I used to like just kind of sits there now. My miniature printer has had the same half-finished figure on it for months, and even yoga or walking in the woods feels like… another chore, not something I actually want to do.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these symptoms been going on for at least a couple of weeks or longer?
Yeah… definitely longer than a couple weeks. It’s been kind of since I got moved into the prototype-testing role… about a year and a month ago, I think.
Have these feelings of low mood and lack of interest been present most of the time, nearly every day, for at least the past two months?
Yeah… most days. It’s been going on since I got moved into that prototype-testing role, about a year and a month ago.
Before this current period of low mood, have you ever had a time when you felt significantly depressed or lost interest in most activities for several weeks or more?
I don’t think so. Not like this, anyway… I mean, I’ve had bad stretches before, but I can’t really remember anything that went on for weeks where I felt this checked out from everything.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight during this time when you’ve been feeling down?
I… I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of my weight or anything. My appetite’s maybe been a little off sometimes, but I don’t know if it’s changed a lot.
Have you noticed a significant change in your appetite or weight over the past year, like eating much less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed anything major like that… I’m not weighing myself or paying close attention. My eating’s been kind of inconsistent, but I can’t say it’s a big change.
Have you noticed that you’ve been moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety more often than not?

Yeah… slower, I think. People at work have started kind of… finishing my sentences in meetings, because I take too long to answer. And even just walking from my desk to the test chamber feels like I’m moving through thick syrup sometimes.
Have you found yourself feeling like a failure or that you’re not living up to expectations, even when others don’t see it that way?

Yeah… I guess. I keep going back over little mistakes in the lab, things other people probably forget about, and it just… turns into me thinking I’m not just bad at the job. Like I’m bad, as a person. And maybe I deserve whatever happens because of it.
